caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing against a plain, light background. She has long, dark hair parted in the center and styled in two loops over her shoulders. She wears a pinkish-purple, off-the-shoulder dress with three-quarter sleeves, decorated with embroidered floral patterns on the bodice and the lower part of the skirt. The skirt of the dress is full and wide, with the hem reaching just above her ankles, and underneath it she wears white lace-trimmed pants or undergarments that extend to her lower calves. The woman's shoes are pointed and green. She stands with her arms relaxed at her sides, holding the sides of her skirt, and has a neutral facial expression. The image is drawn and colored with attention to the textures and patterns of the clothing, while the background remains unembellished.
title: Doll
